Name: FU Finder
Author: stanzhang
Description:
[b]FU Finder[/b]
Don’t hide it.
While learning to create a Stardew Valley mod on a Mac, the author spent an unreasonable amount of time searching for files, folders, paths, hidden directories, and other mysteries.

After thirteen hours of confusion, frustration, and repeatedly asking where things were located, the author reached a simple conclusion:

Complexity was not reduced.

It was merely relocated.

This item reveals information the game chooses not to show.

Unlike Finder.

Cheat on me if you must.

Just don’t hide it.

So, FU Finder.
